description: Java class 'ExampleNettySslContextFactory' that manages SSL context creation for client and server, including TLS protocols, trust managers, and certificate handling within the MockServer project.

classes.name: ExampleNettySslContextFactory
classes.description: Class for creating and managing SSL contexts for client and server with TLS configuration, trust management, and certificate handling.

methods.name: withClientSslContextBuilderFunction
methods.description: Sets a custom function for building SSL contexts for clients.

methods.name: createClientSslContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing SSL context for client connections, with optional proxy trust configurations.

methods.name: forwardProxyPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the private key for the forward proxy, either from a PEM file or generated.

methods.name: forwardProxyCertificateChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain for the forward proxy, either from PEM files or default certificates.

methods.name: jvmCAX509TrustCertificates
methods.description: Builds trust certificates from JVM default trust store and additional certificates.

methods.name: customCAX509TrustCertificates
methods.description: Builds custom trust certificates including the factory's certificates and additional PEM-based certificates.

methods.name: createServerSslContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing SSL context for server, with dynamic certificate management.

methods.name: trustCertificateChain
methods.description: Builds a trust certificate chain from a configured PEM file.
